dedupe_keys.name: resgrid open source computer aided dispatch and resource management for emergency services

description: Resgrid is open-source software for computer-aided dispatch, personnel and unit management and logistics for fire departments, emergency medical services, search and rescue teams, disaster response organisations and companies. It is developed by Resgrid, LLC, which runs the same code base as a hosted service with free and paid plans. Coverage: generic software, used by volunteer and career agencies internationally. Resgrid Core handles calls and incidents with manual and automatic dispatch of personnel, units, roles or groups; unit tracking with automatic vehicle location and accountability; staffing, duty shifts, messaging and chat; run logs and reporting; inventory of equipment and medicines; document storage; notifications on low staffing; and department linking for mutual aid or central dispatch centres, with mobile apps for personnel, units, stations and commanders and a status board. Format and access: .NET source code on GitHub with Docker deployment, a public API and documentation; free to self-host. Licence: Apache 2.0. Caveats: it is operational software, not a dataset, so data exist only in each agency's instance, and self-hosting requires database and messaging services. Simulation uses: a realistic dispatch and resource layer for emergency response exercises and digital twin testbeds of emergency services, and a source of the data structures real agencies keep. Related records: the Austin police computer-aided dispatch incidents (data-apd-computer-aided-dispatch-incidents-p02679) show the kind of records such systems produce, and FireCARES (data-firecares-community-risk-fire-departments) analyses fire department response.
